item.title: Show HN: TchoAI – Transform your documents into editable slide decks
item.summary: Hey Show HN! We are building an AI presentation tool that generates editable slides and charts, built from your documents and data. We are focusing on PowerPoint fidelity and charts that can use data from other connectors. It is still in beta but would appreciate any feedback and suggestion!
